items.title: Sal Gutierrez Interview, 1970-01-15
items.q: Joe was outside, said to me, man, you're just the right guy.

ctx.x: And in Salvador? Well, in Nashville, in Salvador. You got a middle name? Edward. Salvador Edward Gutierrez. Oh, what's today's date, by the way? We ought to have that down on the table. January the… 14th or 15th. Wait a minute, it's on my watch. If I can see my eyes up there. 15th. 1970. I always forget what year it is in January. I got to do it myself. Anyway, your picture is in that book called Jazz Life by… one of the guys' name was Joachim Ernst Berendt. They called him Joe, the guy with glasses.

The fun of how it happened, I was over there trying to park my car and Joe was outside, said to me, man, you're just the right guy. You came in town. You're just at St. Paul Reigns, see? Right. Everybody's here, you. So you take monks' place, see? Oh, yeah. But all the bands ready to go, see? So I got them to start playing and they made some tapes and all and the pictures… But I never did get any tapes or anything, see? Well, I don't know if they ever sent them back or anything. Maybe Joe's gone. Maybe Raymond…

Well, I'll tell you how to get the book, I can give you the address. Give me a call at work and I'll give you the address of the people that put the book out. You know what I'm saying? I don't know. I don't know. I don't know if they ever sent them back or anything. I don't know if they ever sent them back or anything. Maybe Joe's gone. Maybe Raymond knows. You know, I might have to write it up and mail it to you. You don't speak German, I imagine. No, Spanish.
